capture.source: the fleet's originating broker state, readonly; live broker_tasks + tombstones, deduped by task id
capture.groupRule: in-memory repetition grouping (never emitted); identical_work >=3 occurrences, retry ==2, unique ==1
capture.privacy: banded fields only; message text and any digests of it never left the broker host

rules: No holdout record may be scored before this ledger is committed.
Thresholds for arms A/B/C are frozen here before Phase 4 scoring; later changes restart Phase 3 with a new holdout window.
Labels are Phase 2 output; all records ship unlabeled_pending_policy until then.

A_existing_rules.note: degenerate agreement: predicts incomplete for every record, identical to every reviewed label

B_llm.note: predicts proceed for 135/145 (payload presence read as actionable evidence), directly conflicting with the labeling policy's evidence standard; candidate rejected as a replacement

C_jev.note: agrees with the existing rule at the frozen 0.80 act threshold; p_complete skews high but below act threshold on every record

candidate.rationale: arm A is the current behavior and matches all reviewed labels; arm C agrees with it at the pre-frozen 0.80 threshold and adds calibrated probabilities for future escalation gating; arm B as prompted diverges from the reviewed labels

thresholds.source: frozen in the shadow gate before this corpus existed; not tuned on any corpus record

interpretiveCaveats: every label in this window is incomplete, so 1.0-agreement arms are trivially aligned; the discriminating observation is arm B's divergence
no probe- or proceed-labeled records exist in the window, so rule-1/rule-2 paths of any arm are unexercised
Phase 4 holdout (11 records, same window) inherits the same degeneracy; its one-shot scoring stays gated but adds little discriminative power
